# What makes this the modded app rather than upstream.
#
# Checked by .github/scripts/sync-upstream.sh after every upstream merge. A needle that cannot be found in any
# of the listed paths means upstream refactored around one of our features and the merge has to be resolved by
# hand — the pipeline then stops before building, instead of shipping an IPA that quietly lost it.
#
# name|needle|paths (space separated)
audio ladder in the resolver|pickAudioAll|server/src
audio ladder in the stream proxy|audioAll|server/src/stream.ts
audio ladder in the native resolver|rankFormats|server/src/directAudio.ts web/src/native/streams.ts
stream urls can be forgotten and re-picked|forgetUrl|web/src/native/streams.ts
offline cache keyed on the track id|musike.invalid|web/src/lib/offline.ts
native offline downloader|musikeOffline|web/src/lib/offline.ts mobile/ios/App/App/MusikeWebViewController.swift
downloaded tracks remember their length|storedDuration|mobile/ios/App/App/MusikeWebViewController.swift mobile/ios/App/App/MusikeAudio.swift
trimming a padded download|AVAssetExportSession|mobile/ios/App/App/MusikeWebViewController.swift
lyrics from lrclib, server|lrclib|server/src/lyrics.ts
lyrics from lrclib, on the device|lrclib|web/src/native/api.ts
native api retries a refused stream|retryStream|web/src/native/api.ts
offline collection in the UI|downloaded|web/src/views/Collection.tsx
AI playlist assistant|aiPlaylist|server/src/ai.ts web/src/lib/api.ts
AI provider settings stay on the device|musike:ai|web/src/stores/ai.ts
